facts.value: Investigating the reasons behind why people behave the way they do and using knowledge to address important social issues.
This course allows you to examine a fascinating variety of human behaviours and social interactions, and opens up a wide variety of career opportunities.
Develop and deepen your knowledge and understanding of how and why humans think and behave the way they do, and how they shape and are shaped by the society they live in.
Opportunity to undertake a research project on a chosen subject in Psychology.
Knowledge and research skills essential for a career in Psychology.
The BA is accredited by the Psychological Society of Ireland.
The University of Limerick has participated in the ERASMUS programme since 1988.
